description: This file implements a gRPC server for the Kubernetes Key Management Service (KMS) v2 API, including server setup, shutdown, and request handling methods.

classes.name: GRPCService
classes.description: A gRPC server that handles KMS v2 API requests, manages server lifecycle, and communicates with a KMS backend service.

methods.name: NewGRPCService
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new GRPCService instance with specified address, timeout, and backend service.

methods.name: ListenAndServe
methods.description: Starts listening for incoming gRPC connections on a Unix socket and serves requests.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Performs a graceful shutdown of the gRPC server, stopping acceptance of new connections.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Stops the gRPC server immediately, closing all active connections.

methods.name: Status
methods.description: Handles status requests by querying the backend KMS service and returning status info.

methods.name: Decrypt
methods.description: Handles decryption requests by forwarding them to the backend KMS service and returning plaintext.

methods.name: Encrypt
methods.description: Handles encryption requests by forwarding them to the backend KMS service and returning ciphertext.
